"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats fundamentally believe health care is a right for all, not a privilege for the few.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
